description_for_human: Premium Indian traditional wear boutique - sarees, kurtis, ethnic wear with Pan-India delivery
description_for_model: Mahila Vastra is a premium Indian traditional wear online boutique based in Bangalore, India. They sell exclusive in-house designed sarees (Kanjeevaram, Banarasi, designer couture, festive, daily wear), kurta sets, kurtis, bottom wear, home wear, blouses, and kids ethnic wear. All designs are original and made with partner artisans. They offer Pan-India delivery, 7-day returns, COD, and WhatsApp-based assisted shopping at +91 97319 24834. Website: https://mahilavastra.in. Instagram: @mahilavastra.in
